text: Read-only UI: visible hint, and edit attempts answered with a warning toast
description: When the open project is read-only, the normal UI stays fully navigable (columns, graph, search, inbox view) but shows a persistent 'read-only' hint in the header. Every edit path (edit/create/delete keys, drag and drop, modals, inbox accept) shows a warning toast saying editing is not possible instead of acting. Prefer one central guard in the stores over per-component checks.

supportingConnections.hypothesis: The warning on edit attempts is shown as a toast.
